title: Bookings
summary: Appointments and class places for salons and studios. Visitors book, move or cancel; the owner manages services, staff, hours and capacity.

entryPoints.summary: The booking page: a service, who, a free time in the visitor's own zone, then their details.
The confirmation, and the page a booking's signed link opens: add to calendar, move or cancel.
A customer's account: sign up or in, and see their bookings.
The owner's day, opened with Pramaan's owner pass: today, the next week and what is left to set up.
Every booking, as a ruled week calendar or a list; cancel or move one.
Services: name, length, price shown and free time before and after.
Who people book with, their colour, the services they offer and the Staff account each signs in with.
Each person's weekly hours, and days off for one person or the whole business.
Business details, time zone, booking rules, reminders and the owner's own sign-in.
Upcoming classes: book or give up a place (an account is needed).
Add a class with its time and number of places.
Mark a member as staff, then link them to their name on the Staff page so they see their own day.
A linked staff member's own bookings, a day at a time: time, service and customer name.
See whether email is on and the outcome of recent notices.
Search, add, edit and export preparation notes for the business.

owner.summary: The business: sets services, staff, hours and days off, and sees and changes every booking.

member.summary: A customer with an account: sees the bookings they made while signed in, or saved from a link.

visitor.summary: Books with no account, and moves or cancels with the signed link on their confirmation.

staff.summary: A member marked as staff by the owner; once linked to a person on the Staff page, sees that person's own day (customer names only, no emails or phone numbers).

journeys.summary: Picks a service and a free time shown in their own zone, books it, and sees the confirmation; the time is gone for everyone else.
Cancels from the confirmation page with no account, and the time is free again.
Moves the booking to another free time from its link; the old time is freed.
Signs up, books while signed in, and finds the booking under My bookings.
Adds a service with its length, price and buffers, and the booking page offers it.
Sets weekly hours and a day off; the booking page offers only those times.
Names the business, and sees today and the week's bookings as a calendar or a list.
Gets an email confirming the booking, moving it or cancelling it, with the link to change it.
Gets an email for each new, moved or cancelled booking.
Gets a reminder email the day before (the hours are a setting), from the live app's scheduled job.
Pays a deposit when booking, through a payment provider.
Marks a member as staff; the label alone opens nothing.
The owner links a staff account to a person; they sign in, see only their own day and no owner screen.
Searches, adds, edits and exports preparation notes.
Sees plainly when email is off.
Creates a class; members book and cancel their own places without exceeding capacity.

notIncluded: Payments and deposits: prices are shown, nothing is charged (needs the app's egress door and a payment provider)
Password reset, and password change for customers (needs the app email module)
Email verification: no customer's email address is checked
Calendar sync with Google, Outlook or Apple (a booking can be added to one with its calendar file)
Video meeting links, and text-message reminders
Bookings that wait for approval: every booking is confirmed straight away
Waiting lists, no-show tracking and limits on bookings per customer
Email and scheduled jobs are off by default: until they're on, nothing is emailed and no reminders run, and the app says so
Going live with data needs the platform's live database, which is off by default
Other languages: the app is in English
Classes have a separate timetable from staff appointments; no recurring classes or group checkout.
Platform organisation accounts and team details are not included.
Staff see only their own day's bookings, with customer names: they cannot move, cancel or add bookings, or see customers' emails or phone numbers.
Classes cannot be edited or cancelled after they are added, and the owner cannot see who booked.
